mcq.stem: Purchasing cyber insurance is an example of which risk treatment?

choices.text: Acceptance of all residual risk without analysis

mcq.explanation: Insurance transfers financial impact to another party.

mcq.stem: Canceling a project because residual risk is unacceptable is:
mcq.explanation: Avoidance means not taking the risky activity at all.

mcq.stem: A quantitative risk analysis expresses loss primarily in:

choices.text: Only color codes with no numbers

mcq.explanation: Quantitative methods assign dollar figures to likelihood and impact.

mcq.stem: ALE equals:
mcq.explanation: Annualized Loss Expectancy is Single Loss Expectancy times Annual Rate of Occurrence.

mcq.stem: GDPR and similar laws primarily drive which organizational concern?

choices.text: Privacy and lawful processing of personal data

mcq.explanation: Privacy regulations require lawful, transparent handling of personal information.

mcq.stem: Data minimization means:

choices.text: Collecting and retaining only what is needed for the stated purpose
Storing every log forever without review

mcq.explanation: Minimize collection/retention to reduce privacy and breach impact.

mcq.stem: Change management’s security value is MAINLY to:

choices.text: Reduce unauthorized or poorly tested modifications that cause outages or exposures

mcq.explanation: Formal change control catches risky changes before production.

mcq.stem: A rollback plan in a change record exists to:

choices.text: Restore the prior known-good state if the change fails

mcq.explanation: Backout plans limit blast radius when deployments go wrong.

mcq.stem: An acceptable use policy (AUP) primarily sets:

choices.text: Rules for how employees may use corporate systems and data

mcq.explanation: AUPs communicate permitted and prohibited technology use.

mcq.stem: Job rotation and mandatory vacations can help detect:

choices.text: Fraud or unauthorized practices hidden by a single person

mcq.explanation: Another person performing duties may uncover concealed misuse.

mcq.stem: Which TWO statements about residual risk are true?

choices.text: It remains after controls are applied
It is always zero after any firewall is installed
It cannot be discussed in audits

mcq.explanation: Controls reduce but rarely eliminate risk; acceptance is a valid treatment.

mcq.stem: A BIA (business impact analysis) identifies:

choices.text: Critical processes and the impact of their disruption

mcq.explanation: BIAs drive RTO/RPO and continuity priorities.

mcq.stem: Data retention schedules should balance:

choices.text: Legal/business needs against privacy and storage risk

mcq.explanation: Keep data as required, delete when no longer needed or allowed.

mcq.stem: Separation of duties BEST prevents:

choices.text: One person both requesting and approving high-risk actions alone

mcq.explanation: Splitting conflicting roles reduces fraud and error.

mcq.stem: Security awareness training is MOST effective when it is:

choices.text: Role-relevant, recurring, and measured (e.g., phishing simulations)
A one-time unread PDF at hire only

mcq.explanation: Continuous, relevant training with feedback changes behavior.

mcq.stem: Third-party risk assessments should occur:

choices.text: Before onboarding and periodically during the relationship
Only after a breach is public

mcq.explanation: Vendors introduce ongoing risk that needs initial and continuous review.

mcq.stem: Right-to-audit clauses in contracts help customers:

choices.text: Verify a vendor’s security controls when needed

mcq.explanation: Contractual audit rights support assurance beyond marketing claims.

mcq.stem: Which TWO are privacy-enhancing practices?

choices.text: Publishing full SSNs on public wikis
Unlimited retention of all customer PII by default

mcq.explanation: Pseudonymization and purpose limits reduce privacy risk.

mcq.stem: A risk register is used to:

choices.text: Track identified risks, owners, treatments, and status

mcq.explanation: Registers provide an authoritative inventory of enterprise risks.

mcq.stem: An emergency change process should still require:

choices.text: Expedited approval, documentation, and post-implementation review

mcq.explanation: Emergencies accelerate change but must remain accountable and reviewable.
